meta's new portable VR hardware concept is taking a totally different path.
positioned right between quest 3 and vision pro at $1,299, but with a twist: to shave off weight, it offloads the chip, battery, and 128GB storage into a pocket puck via a fiber optic cable.
not coming until spring 2027, but the strategy is clear-zuck is sacrificing the all-in-one form factor to win on comfort and price against apple. compute offloading might actually be the move for mass adoption.

META Stock Slips After Connect Launches, But Analysts Believe Muse AI Is 'A Game-Changer'

trends.summary: Metas Muse AI agent and its reported early user traction are driving attention, with traders weighing its potential to expand Metas consumer AI and advertising business against doubts about monetization, privacy, and heavy AI spending. Meta Connects new glasses and other device announcements drew mixed reviews, while the event prompted debate over whether the recent rally can continue or may give way to a sell-the-news pullback.

Alphabets sharp selloff is fueling debate over whether Metas Muse AI launch could threaten Googles search and AI position; many traders view the competitive risk as overstated, while others see it as a reason for pressure on GOOGL. Rising Treasury yields and expectations of further rate hikes are also cited as weighing on growth stocks broadly.
